rows.commentary: 0.1: Kim Garth delivers from the crease as Georgia Plimmer slices a cut behind point for a brisk couple.
0.2: Kim Garth finds the right length outside off and beats Georgia Plimmer's flashing blade entirely.
0.3: Kim Garth floats a fuller delivery past the charging Georgia Plimmer as she looks to drive.
0.4: Kim Garth extracts movement off the pitch, inducing an inside edge from Georgia Plimmer right into the turf.
0.5: Kim Garth angles one in from a back of a length, allowing Georgia Plimmer to guide a single to deep point.
0.6: Kim Garth lands it full, angling into off stump as Flora Devonshire skips down the pitch and mistimes her drive straight to midwicket.
1.1: Sophie Molineux darts the arm ball in, catching Georgia Plimmer on the pad as she leaps forward to defend.
1.2: Sophie Molineux drifts this one down leg at 79 kilometres per hour, and Georgia Plimmer sweeps it straight to backward square in the ring.
1.3: Sophie Molineux floats it on leg at 82 kilometres per hour, and Georgia Plimmer pushes it down to long-on for a single.
1.4: Sophie Molineux tosses it up on a good length at 79kph, tempting Flora Devonshire down the track to punch it straight to mid-off.
1.5: Sophie Molineux fires in a flatter delivery at 82kph on leg stump, forcing Flora Devonshire to scurry a single off the inside half toward the midwicket sweeper.
1.6: Sophie Molineux drifts an 87kph delivery into middle, where Georgia Plimmer sweeps firmly but picks out short fine leg to end the over.
2.2: Kim Garth bowls a wide to Amelia Kerr.
2.1: Kim Garth strikes with late inward movement, beating Flora Devonshire all ends up to send the off bail flying and end a brief stay at the crease.
2.2: Kim Garth delivers a full, wide-shaping beauty at 108kph that Amelia Kerr meets solidly, sending it straight to mid-off.
2.3: Kim Garth bowls a wide to Amelia Kerr.
2.3: Dot ball from Kim Garth to Amelia Kerr.
2.4: Kim Garth finds that nagging fourth-stump channel with subtle away-shape, forcing Amelia Kerr to drive aerially on the up straight to cover.
2.5: Garth takes the pace right down to 91kph with a clever back-of-a-length slower ball, safely punched off the back foot by Melie Kerr towards cover-point.
2.6: Georgia Plimmer takes 2 off Kim Garth.
3.1: Lucy Hamilton offers a full delivery that drifts away, allowing Amelia Kerr to steer a square drive down to deep point for a single.
3.2: Lucy Hamilton sends down a fuller 108kph delivery angling across the batter, which Georgia Plimmer punches solidly straight to the cover fielder.
3.3: Lucy Hamilton delivers a good-length ball at 110kph that Georgia Plimmer aggressively charges down to dispatch straight past the stumps with tremendous force for a boundary.
3.4: Lucy Hamilton persists with a wider, full 107kph delivery that Georgia Plimmer taps firmly toward the fielder stationed at mid-off on the circle.
3.5: Lucy Hamilton delivers to Georgia Plimmer, who skips down the track to a good length and unleashes a powerful bottom-handed whip over midwicket for a boundary.
3.6: Lucy Hamilton targets the fourth-stump channel on a good length, prompting Georgia Plimmer to shuffle across and nudge the ball toward mid-on to scamper a quick single.
4.2: Dot ball from Annabel Sutherland to Georgia Plimmer.
4.3: Annabel Sutherland slides one through the gate past Georgia Plimmer, eluding Mooney's gloves in a flash.
4.4: Annabel Sutherland digs in a sharp one hundred and three kph short delivery that catches Georgia Plimmer high on the arm.
4.5: Annabel Sutherland offers a fourth-stump length, but Georgia Plimmer carves it with immense authority square of point for four.
4.6: Sutherland delivers to Plimmer, who pushes the slower ball off a good length toward midwicket to rotate the strike for a single.
5.1: Sophie Molineux tosses it up, and Georgia Plimmer dances down the track to drill it away to long-on for a single.
5.2: Sophie Molineux loops this one onto off stump, inviting Amelia Kerr to drop to one knee and sweep it briskly out to deep midwicket for a comfortable run.
5.3: Sophie Molineux gets this delivery drifting into middle as Georgia Plimmer shuffles across, only to sweep it straight into the hands of short fine.
5.4: Sophie Molineux loops it down leg, Georgia Plimmer advances to work it away off the pad, and Amelia Kerr responds instantly to pinch a single through the off side.
5.5: Sophie Molineux floats up a tempting delivery on the fourth stump at 84kph, but Amelia Kerr simply pushes it straight back down the pitch to the bowler.
5.6: Amelia Kerr takes 2 off Sophie Molineux.
6.3: No-ball from Annabel Sutherland to Amelia Kerr.
6.3: Dot ball from Annabel Sutherland to Amelia Kerr.
6.4: Annabel Sutherland strikes with precision as Amelia Kerr miscues the shot straight to Lucy Hamilton to depart for nine.
6.6: Annabel Sutherland targets the fourth stump with a sharp back-of-a-length delivery, and Maddy Green attempts the pull only to drag it off the inside edge straight into her pad for no run.
7.1: Georgia Wareham tosses it up and Georgia Plimmer skips down the track to pierce the gap through cover for a crisp boundary.
7.2: Georgia Wareham drops this leg-break on a good length at 76kph, which Georgia Plimmer pushes back from the crease toward midwicket.
7.3: Georgia Wareham gets her reward as Georgia Plimmer dances down the pitch only to wear it flush on the pad outside leg.
7.6: Georgia Wareham drops it straighter into the middle, and Georgia Plimmer dances down the track to whip it away into the deep midwicket grass for a single.
8.1: Lucy Hamilton attacks full and outside off, catching Georgia Plimmer on the pad as the ball trickles away for a leg bye.
8.2: Lucy Hamilton serves it full outside off, and Maddy Green clears the front leg to thump it straight past mid-off for four.
8.3: Lucy Hamilton delivers full on leg stump, allowing Maddy Green to whip it out towards deep midwicket for a single.
8.4: Lucy Hamilton tosses up a slower delivery too full, and Georgia Plimmer reads it to lift over mid-on with her bottom hand for four.
8.5: Lucy Hamilton bowls an 82kph slower ball that Georgia Plimmer reaches for and slices high over mid-off to race away to the boundary.
8.6: Lucy Hamilton rushes an 110kph climbing delivery outside off that catches Georgia Plimmer's edge and drops out of Mooney's gloves.
9.1: Ashleigh Gardner tosses one up outside off, and Maddy Green unleashes a powerful reverse sweep that races past short third to the rope.
9.2: Ashleigh Gardner keeps it shorter on the leg side, and Maddy Green responds by pulling it toward deep square for a single.
9.3: Ashleigh Gardner delivers to Georgia Plimmer, who expertly carves the ball past point for a boundary.
9.4: Ashleigh Gardner drops on a good length with turn into middle, and Georgia Plimmer steps back to tuck it safely forward of square for a single.
9.5: Ashleigh Gardner tosses one up outside off, inviting Maddy Green to drive with the spin down to long-on for one run.
9.6: Ashleigh Gardner fires a shorter ball into middle, where Georgia Plimmer moves back to punch it toward long-on for a single.
10.1: Kim Garth overcorrects down leg, allowing Georgia Plimmer room to effortlessly glance it past short fine leg for four.
10.2: Kim Garth pitches up outside leg, clipped away to deep midwicket as Georgia Plimmer brings up her fifty off forty balls to a warm ovation.
10.3: Kim Garth serves a full delivery on middle at ninety-one kph, which Maddy Green knocks down to long-on for a single.
10.4: Georgia Plimmer does not score off Kim Garth.
10.5: Kim Garth drops it full on leg stump, punched down the ground to long-on by Georgia Plimmer for a comfortable single.
10.6: Kim Garth delivers full and wide outside off, steered firmly toward mid-off by Maddy Green as they scamper through for one.
11.1: Sophie Molineux darts this into leg and Maddy Green carves a thick inside edge away through square leg for a single.
11.2: Sophie Molineux traps Georgia Plimmer on the pad with a gripping delivery, surviving a fierce review as ball tracking confirms umpire's call clipping leg.
11.3: Sophie Molineux loops it up full and wide, allowing Georgia Plimmer to steer the drive down to long-off for a single.
11.4: Sophie Molineux drops it fractionally short, and Maddy Green rocks back to violently pull it forward of square into the gap between the sweepers for four.
11.5: Sophie Molineux drops it shorter on off, and Maddy Green moves back to force a single out to long-on.
11.6: Sophie Molineux drops it on a good length, and Georgia Plimmer dances down the track to loft it cleanly over cover for two brisk runs.
12.1: Annabel Sutherland targets the full length outside off, drawing a thick inside edge off Maddy Green's bat down to deep square leg for a single.
12.2: Annabel Sutherland digs this one back of a length and wide of off, allowing Georgia Plimmer to slice a cut off the toe toward cover for one.
12.4: Sutherland digs it back of a length and wide outside off, testing Green who shapes to cut but finds only thin air at 111 clicks.
12.5: Wide from Annabel Sutherland to Maddy Green.
12.5: A single to Maddy Green off Annabel Sutherland.
12.6: A single to Georgia Plimmer off Annabel Sutherland.
13.1: Georgia Wareham tosses it wide outside off at eighty kilometres per hour, inviting Georgia Plimmer to skip down the pitch and mistime her drive toward cover for a single.
13.2: Georgia Wareham loops up another delivery outside off, and Maddy Green accepts the invitation to drive it firmly down to long-off for one run.
13.3: Georgia Wareham almost finds the breakthrough against Georgia Plimmer with a delivery that beats the bat and nearly crashes into the stumps for a dot ball.
13.4: Georgia Wareham tosses it up on the stumps, allowing Georgia Plimmer to clip it away comfortably to long-on for a single.
13.5: Georgia Wareham floats one in, and Maddy Green attempts the reverse sweep with the spin, only to find the fielder straight at short third.
13.6: Georgia Wareham serves a teasing delivery on off, prompting Maddy Green to dance down the track and hammer it straight back into the bowler's hands.
14.3: Nicola Carey drops it full and wide, Georgia Plimmer drives fiercely straight back at the bowler, and it deflects off the shoe toward mid-off for a single.
14.4: Carey drops the fuller delivery in, angling toward the stumps, and Green neatly sweeps it behind square for a single.
14.5: Carey feeds a short ball into the leg side, and Plimmer absolutely detonates a pull shot sailing all the way over the ropes onto the hill for six.
14.6: Carey rolls out a sluggish ninety-kilometer-per-hour delivery wide outside off, which Plimmer punches firmly on the rise out to deep cover for one.
15.3: Georgia Wareham slides one through, and Georgia Plimmer shuffling across tangles her feet into a self-inflicted yorker, beating back the drive harmlessly to the bowler.
15.4: Wareham floats this up and Plimmer advances to punch a single down to long-on.
15.5: Wareham drifts this onto the pads, allowing Green to whip it firmly out to deep midwicket for one.
15.6: Wareham tosses up an eighty-click delivery that Plimmer hammers wide of long-on, though Sutherland saves two with a sprawling dive.
16.3: Maddy Green clears the boundary off Kim Garth for six.
16.4: Maddy Green finds the boundary off Kim Garth for four.
16.5: A single to Maddy Green off Kim Garth.
16.6: Georgia Plimmer takes a single off Kim Garth.
17.1: Sophie Molineux floats one up outside off, and Georgia Plimmer aggressively steps across to heave it with immense power straight of deep midwicket for a boundary.
17.2: Sophie Molineux tosses it up on the leg stump, allowing Georgia Plimmer to whip it cleanly away to deep midwicket for a single.
17.3: Sophie Molineux darts the ball sharply into the leg stump, prompting Maddy Green to clip it toward Gardner stationed at deep midwicket for a quick run.
17.4: Sophie Molineux darts one into the leg stump, allowing Georgia Plimmer to sweep behind square and hustle back industriously for a sharp two runs.
17.5: Sophie Molineux watches as Georgia Plimmer marches down the track to launch a forceful drive straight down the ground toward long-on for a single.
17.6: Molineux delivers to Green, who steps down and squeezes a drive out toward long-on for a single.
18.1: Sutherland drops a 108kph low full toss onto middle stump, clipped away by Green toward deep midwicket.
18.2: Sutherland rolls out an 83kph slower ball outside off, firmly driven by Plimmer down to long-on.
18.3: Sutherland floats a slower delivery outside off as Green shuffles across to scoop it straight into Mooney.
18.4: Wide from Annabel Sutherland to Maddy Green, 2 runs in all.
18.5: Maddy Green finds the boundary off Annabel Sutherland for four.
18.6: Maddy Green takes a single off Annabel Sutherland.
19.1: Wareham drifts it past the pads of Maddy Green, squeezing out a sharp leg bye.
19.2: Plimmer shuffles across to that full delivery from Wareham, turning it behind square to hustle back for two.
19.3: Wareham tosses it up full on off, allowing Plimmer to skip down the track and drill it down to long-on for a single.
19.4: Georgia Wareham drops the ball full, and Maddy Green skips down to mistime a single out to deep midwicket.
19.5: Georgia Wareham tosses it up on off, prompting Georgia Plimmer to advance and drive firmly toward long-on for one.
19.6: Georgia Wareham unleashes a full toss outside off, which Maddy Green swings at hard and miscues to deep midwicket to hustle back for a pair.
0.1: Bree Illing targets the stumps first up, inducing a straight-bat push right back down the pitch from Georgia Voll.
NZW finish their innings strongly, posting 162 on the board at North Sydney Oval!
0.2: Bree Illing traps Georgia Voll plumb in front with an inswinging delivery that the batter leaves alone at her peril, confirmed by the umpire's call on review.
0.6: Bree Illing targets the stumps, and Ellyse Perry solidly defends it back from the crease without offering a run.
1.1: Jess Kerr drops it short outside off, turning to Beth Mooney who pulls it away into the deep square leg region for a single.
1.2: Jess Kerr pushes it full and angling into the pads, Ellyse Perry launching an aerial whip that safely drops just short of the fielder at deep square.
1.3: Jess Kerr delivers a 98kph short and wide offering, sliced powerfully through point by Beth Mooney to comfortably scamper back for a couple.
1.4: Jess Kerr delivers on a good length as Beth Mooney advances down the track, mistiming her drive into the turf straight toward mid-off where a sharp stop keeps it to a single.
1.5: Jess Kerr bowls a wide to Ellyse Perry.
1.5: Ellyse Perry takes 2 off Jess Kerr.
1.6: Four to Ellyse Perry off Jess Kerr.
2.1: Bree Illing delivers full outside leg, and Beth Mooney marches down to stroke a majestic check drive straight to the boundary.
2.2: Bree Illing darts one short outside off, trapping Beth Mooney into a pull shot straight into the hands of midwicket.
2.3: Bree Illing serves it full once more, and Beth Mooney steps down to club it firmly along the turf straight of mid-off for four.
2.5: Bree Illing targets the stumps with a medium-pace delivery, and Beth Mooney meets it firmly, stroking the ball down to mid-on to collect a single.
2.6: Bree Illing delivers back of a length angled across, and Ellyse Perry walks down leg side to carve a thick edge past short third that races away to the boundary.
3.1: Nensi Patel drops short to Beth Mooney, who rocks back and pulls it away emphatically to the fence for four.
3.2: Nensi Patel tosses one up on the leg stump, allowing Beth Mooney to push a simple single out toward mid-on.
3.3: Nensi Patel drifts this full delivery wide, and Ellyse Perry slices a precise square drive behind point for four.
3.4: Nensi Patel flights this delivery at seventy kilometers per hour, prompting Ellyse Perry to advance down the track and block it solidly.
3.5: Nensi Patel delivers from middle stump, but Ellyse Perry's ambitious reverse sweep loops safely just short of backward point for no score.
3.6: Nensi Patel serves it up on the leg side, and Ellyse Perry charges down to clip it wide of long-on, scurrying back hard for a couple of runs.
4.1: Wide from Rosemary Mair to Beth Mooney.
4.1: A single to Beth Mooney off Rosemary Mair.
4.2: Four to Ellyse Perry off Rosemary Mair.
4.3: No run for Ellyse Perry off Rosemary Mair.
4.4: Four to Ellyse Perry off Rosemary Mair.
4.5: Ellyse Perry takes a single off Rosemary Mair.
4.6: A single to Beth Mooney off Rosemary Mair.
AUSW are cruising at 49 for 1 after 4.5 overs, needing 114 more to secure an almost certain victory against NZW.
5.1: Jess Kerr delivers full and wide, and Beth Mooney backs away to loft it effortlessly over cover for four.
5.2: Jess Kerr targets the leg stump, allowing Beth Mooney to glance the ball away toward deep backward square for a single.
5.3: Jess Kerr fires in an inswinging yorker, which Ellyse Perry manages to jam out sharply into the offside for one run.
5.4: Jess Kerr offers a low full toss wide of off, and Beth Mooney pushes her drive straight to mid-off for no run.
5.5: Jess Kerr sends down a full delivery on off at ninety-five kilometers per hour, driven firmly by Beth Mooney to mid-off.
5.6: Jess Kerr delivers a short ball wide of off stump, allowing Beth Mooney to slice a cut shot away to deep point for a single.
6.1: Mooney advances to carve the width, skewing a thick edge safely over the scrambling fielder at short third for a racing boundary.
6.2: Illing strays down the leg side, glancing off the thigh pad and sprinting all the way to the rope for four leg byes.
6.3: Bree Illing unleashes a shoulder-high bumper that Beth Mooney mistimes into a pull through midwicket to pinch a single.
6.4: Bree Illing targets off-stump, but Ellyse Perry premeditates the trajectory masterfully, scooping the full delivery over short fine leg for a sublime boundary.
6.5: A single to Ellyse Perry off Bree Illing.
6.6: Beth Mooney takes 2 off Bree Illing.
7.1: Amelia Kerr drifts one in, Ellyse Perry drops to sweep, and the ball cannons away off the pad into the stifling silence of the cordon.
7.2: Ellyse Perry dances down the track, defies the turn with a breathtaking whip through midwicket, and races the ball to the rope.
7.3: Amelia Kerr loops it up on middle and Ellyse Perry delicately scoops it away behind square for a neat couple of runs.
7.4: Amelia Kerr drifts this one down the leg side, allowing Ellyse Perry to stroke it firmly out toward long-on for a single.
7.5: Amelia Kerr serves up a full toss on off stump that Beth Mooney laps fine, and Halliday makes a mess of the fielding attempt at fine leg to concede a boundary.
7.6: Amelia Kerr floats this leg-spinner through at sixty-six kilometers per hour, teasing it into the stumps, and Beth Mooney dead-bats it firmly toward midwicket.
8.1: Rosemary Mair attacks the top of off with a probing length, and Ellyse Perry punches it firmly into the covers to hustle through for a sharp single.
8.2: Rosemary Mair angles it in full to Beth Mooney, whose impulsive dash for a non-existent single ends in a chaotic run-out engineered by Bree Illing.
8.3: Rosemary Mair attacks the crease with a full delivery wide of off at 111kph, inviting Ashleigh Gardner to stroke a square drive out toward deep cover-point for a single.
8.4: Wide from Rosemary Mair to Ellyse Perry.
8.4: A single to Ellyse Perry off Rosemary Mair.
8.5: Dot ball from Rosemary Mair to Ashleigh Gardner.
8.6: A single to Ashleigh Gardner off Rosemary Mair.
9.2: Amelia Kerr floats this wide outside off, and Ellyse Perry lofts it over backward point to fetch a boundary.
9.6: Amelia Kerr fires it down leg, allowing Ellyse Perry to step back and nudge a single through midwicket.
10.1: Jess Kerr releases a probing full delivery outside the off stump, leaving Ellyse Perry completely beaten as her bat swishes past empty space without making contact.
10.2: Jess Kerr snares the prized scalp of Ellyse Perry, who holes out to Izzy Sharp in the deep to depart for a blistering fifty-two.
10.3: Jess Kerr drops it on a good length outside off, drawing a defensive prod from Georgia Wareham that takes a thick edge and trickles away to short third.
10.4: Jess Kerr bangs it short and wide, allowing Georgia Wareham to throw her hands at it and crack a sharp cut out to deep point for a single.
10.5: Jess Kerr decelerates the pace with a crafty legcutter, drawing Ashleigh Gardner into a checked drive with an open bat face straight to backward point.
10.6: Jess Kerr serves it full on off, prompting Ashleigh Gardner to loft it high inside out over mid-off, extracting more height than length as the ball drops safely just inside the rope for a pair.
11.1: Amelia Kerr delivers full to middle, prompting Georgia Wareham to retreat and punch the ball through cover-point for a single.
11.2: Amelia Kerr darts the ball into the leg stump, allowing Ashleigh Gardner to step back and nudge it forward of square for one.
11.3: Amelia Kerr fires down a wrong-un outside leg, catching Georgia Wareham on the pad as she dances down the crease to turn it square.
11.4: Amelia Kerr attacks a good length with a leg break, but Georgia Wareham charges down to launch it powerfully over mid-off for four.
11.5: Amelia Kerr tosses one up on leg stump, only for Georgia Wareham to sweep it fiercely through square leg to pick up another boundary.
11.6: Amelia Kerr angles a shorter delivery outside off, and Georgia Wareham slices a thick edge straight to Nensi Patel at backward point to depart for 10.
12.1: Rosemary Mair drops it back, offering width as Ashleigh Gardner hangs back and punches straight to cover for a dot.
12.2: Rosemary Mair attacks the pads with a full delivery, clipped away via a thick inside edge to short fine leg for a single.

12.3: Rosemary Mair attacks from over the wicket with a cross-seamer wide of off, Annabel Sutherland shapes early for the scoop but makes no contact, and as Inglis fumbles behind the stumps, they scramble through for a leg bye.
12.4: Rosemary Mair rolls out a clever slower ball, inviting Ashleigh Gardner to scoop it fine into the vacant spaces for a hard-run couple.
12.5: Rosemary Mair feeds a low full toss on off stump that Ashleigh Gardner drops down to scoop away to the fence for four.
12.6: Rosemary Mair attacks wide of off with a low full toss, punched by Ashleigh Gardner toward deep cover for a single.
13.1: Melie Kerr fires a wrong un down leg, turned away by Gardner toward deep backward square to collect a run.
13.2: Amelia Kerr tosses one up outside off, inviting Annabel Sutherland to skip down and drive past cover for four.
13.6: Amelia Kerr loops it up to Annabel Sutherland, who cracks a ferocious slog sweep into the grass, watching it race wide of long-on all the way to the rope for four.
